## Problem

Finance admins reconcile widget spending in spreadsheets every month. Today the widget table has no export action, so admins copy each visible row by hand and make transcription errors. - As a finance admin, I want to export widgets, so that I can reconcile spending.

- Given the current package manifest, when CSV export is installed, then dependency declarations remain unchanged. Explicit requirement r-2: "Do not add dependencies."

- src/export/

- PDF export and unrelated table changes.

## Assumptions

- Export includes the currently visible rows.

# Export widgets from the table

## Problem

Finance admins reconcile widget spending in spreadsheets every month. Today the widget table has no export action, so admins copy each visible row by hand and make transcription errors. A scoped export will preserve the selected records and their values while making the monthly reconciliation repeatable and reducing manual work for these users.

## User stories

- As a finance admin, I want to export widgets, so that I can reconcile spending.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given a table with three widgets, when Export is selected, then the requested file contains exactly three widget rows.
- Given the current package manifest, when CSV export is installed, then dependency declarations remain unchanged. Explicit requirement r-2: "Do not add dependencies."
- Given a table with three widgets, when Export is selected, then the requested file contains exactly three widget rows. Explicit requirement a-q-r-1-1: "Use CSV and the selected format document."

## Verify

- `npm test`
- `npm run lint`

## Where to look

- src/export/

## Out of scope

- PDF export and unrelated table changes.

## Assumptions

- Export includes the currently visible rows.
